## Summary
When class:architectural is detected (S4), brainstorm dispatches an architectural-probe sub-agent that must produce at least one end-to-end test scaffold or integration-harness spec file before scrutiny passes.

## Done Definitions
- When class:architectural, probe sub-agent dispatched before scrutiny gate
- Probe produces end-to-end test scaffold or integration-harness spec file
- Scrutiny gate checks probe output exists and is non-empty
- Negative test: class:behavioral does NOT trigger probe dispatch
- Negative test: probe failure (empty output) causes brainstorm gate to refuse

## SC Coverage
SC5

## Depends On
S4 (architectural classification must be available)

## Escalation Policy
Escalate when blocked
